step: STEP 37-38 — Release Stabilization and Character Audit

audit.detail: Full audit of repository, character assets (player.glb 43KB, murugan.glb 12KB — procedural primitives), all core systems, and previous QA reports

ending_system.detail: EndingController.cs (389 lines) + QuestEndingBridge.cs (107 lines) bridges QuestManager.OnQuestCompleted → EndingController.EvaluateEnding(). Wired into AssembleAllRegions.SetupCommonManagers() for all region scenes.

npc_navigation.detail: maxNavMeshSampleDistance increased from 5m to 15m, added NavMesh.SamplePosition + agent.Warp after agent creation. Fixes 7 Chennai NPCs that failed NavMesh binding.

vendor_economy.detail: VendorInteraction.cs (339 lines) with atomic buy/sell. SetupTeaWorkerVendor.cs editor script attaches it to NPC_TeaWorker.prefab with configured stock.

campaign_flow_integration.detail: EndingController.ResetForNewGame() wired into CampaignFlow. QuestEndingBridge auto-subscribes when both managers available.

character_asset_audit.detail: All character models are procedurally generated from primitive shapes (boxes/cylinders). player.glb ~168 triangles. Replacing requires Blender/3D tools not available.

graphics_fix.detail: Cascade shadow atlasing error requires scene-level light configuration in Unity editor

tests.detail: Step37ReleaseStabilizationTests.cs: 22 NUnit editor tests covering EndingController, QuestEndingBridge, VendorInteraction, NPCWallet, NPCNavigationController, RegionUnlocks

endingSystem.endingA: Heritage affinity≥60, avg trust≥50, ≥5 clues, LivingSanctuary verdict
endingSystem.endingD: ≥7 clues, ≥4 milestones, ≥5 central NPCs at trust≥70, LivingSanctuary verdict
